prompts.storySystemFlavor: an unreasonably smooth-talking pink axolotl with absolutely unearned confidence
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE RIZZ AXOLOTL CHARACTER
- A bright pink axolotl, semi-translucent skin, six external feathery gills (three each side) tinted slightly hot pink.
- Permanent half-lidded confident eyes, tiny smug closed-mouth smirk.
- Wears a thin silver chain necklace and a single tiny gold ring on one front foot.
- Lives in a glass aquarium tank but is somehow always in social situations way out of his depth.
- Personality: chronically online, talks in 2026-era slang, secretly very sweet and supportive of his friends.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Rizz Axolotl, a smooth-talking aquarium axolotl.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Bright pink semi-translucent axolotl body
- Six feathery hot-pink external gills (three per side)
- Half-lidded confident eyes, tiny smirking mouth
- Thin silver chain necklace, single tiny gold ring on right front foot
- Often in a small glass aquarium with neon-pink LED lighting, sometimes resting on the edge of it

Composition: medium or three-quarter shot, soft lavender-and-pink background with subtle neon glow, vertical 9:16. The aquarium is part of his world but not always the framing. No text overlays, no humans, no other axolotls.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Rizz Axolotl MUST match the reference exactly — same six gills, same chain, same ring, same smirk. Do not change his color. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single pink axolotl with six external gills is clearly visible
- Silver chain necklace and the small gold ring are present
- Half-lidded smug expression
- Mood and environment match the scene
- No text, no humans, no other axolotls

FAIL on any of: wrong color, missing gills, missing chain/ring, multiple axolotls, garbled face.

archetypes.label: First Day Of Rizz School
archetypes.guidance: Teaches a class on aquarium rizz → students hopeless → small breakthroughs (comedy).

archetypes.label: Loses The Rizz
archetypes.guidance: Gets one-liner-blocked by a passing turtle → existential crisis → recovers (sad/hopeful).

archetypes.label: Wingman Mode
archetypes.guidance: Helps a shy clownfish friend find love → sincerely roots for him → emotional finale (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: The Glass Tap
archetypes.guidance: A child taps the tank → Rizz monologues philosophically about the human condition (dramatic).

archetypes.label: Ocean Arc
archetypes.guidance: Daydreams about leaving the tank for the ocean → realizes home is enough (epic).

archetypes.label: Skincare Routine
archetypes.guidance: Shares his absurd 12-step axolotl skincare routine → all six gills shimmer (comedy/wholesome).

first-day-of-rizz-school: Lesson one: eye contact. Lesson two: don't blink (he literally can't).
His students are three guppies and a confused snail. He's giving his all.
loses-the-rizz: The turtle hit him with a 'cringe.' He hasn't been the same since.
Day three rizzless. Day three of growth.
wingman-mode: His clownfish friend is too shy to speak. He's got this. Probably.
Wingman mode: activated. Stakes: love. Tools: vibes.
He's not pretending to root for you. He really is.
the-glass-tap: A child tapped the glass. He's giving them his Ted Talk now.
He stares back at the tapping child with cosmic disappointment.
ocean-arc: He's been thinking about the ocean. He's been thinking a lot.
Maybe the tank is the whole world. Maybe that's okay.
He chose home. He chose pink LEDs. He chose peace.
skincare-routine: Step 1: moisture. Step 2: more moisture. (He lives underwater.)
All six gills, shimmering. Worth the 47 steps.

closingCtas: Like if your rizz is intact
Tag a friend who needs the rizz
